'''M1-L0''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
M1-L0 first appeared in the online game, ''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'', as a companion unlockable through the code: aquaassaultprize.
